packageStages.name: Discover
packageStages.description: Find businesses from permitted public, licensed, official, and merchant-direct sources.

packageStages.name: Normalize
packageStages.description: Map names, categories, addresses, currencies, languages, rights, and country codes into one schema.

packageStages.name: Deduplicate
packageStages.description: Resolve duplicate branches, aliases, moved businesses, chains, franchises, and copied listings.

packageStages.name: Verify
packageStages.description: Confirm legal identity, provider control, capacity, accessibility, pricing authority, licenses, insurance, and payout destination.

packageStages.name: Source locally first
packageStages.description: Build the package around businesses near the destination to reduce shipping, transport, leakage, and complexity.

packageStages.name: Negotiate bulk capacity
packageStages.description: Request direct prices for room blocks, meals, rides, attractions, products, and support with exact dates and cancellation terms.

packageStages.name: Forecast demand
packageStages.description: Predict likely destinations, dates, accessibility needs, package sizes, product use, and cancellation risk without exposing personal data.

packageStages.name: Stage inventory
packageStages.description: Move durable products or reserve service capacity near likely destinations while avoiding unsafe speculative stockpiles.

packageStages.name: Assemble package
packageStages.description: Combine typed Store Claims into one vacation, move, housing, health, work, or product package.

packageStages.name: Close the funding gap
packageStages.description: Use contracted discounts, public programs, sponsor budgets, merchant promotion, donations, or Infinity profit pools with every source disclosed.

packageStages.name: Fulfill and settle
packageStages.description: Reserve claims, confirm delivery through NFC, QR, passkey, receipt, or provider evidence, then settle each provider.

packageStages.name: Learn and recirculate
packageStages.description: Measure actual use, satisfaction, refunds, accessibility, local economic impact, fraud, and unused capacity for the next package.
